title: Security
description: Review what the guardrails flagged, choose which rules block, and investigate incidents. Nothing is blocked until you turn a rule on.

posture.title: Current exposure
posture.description: Live reads of the people, credentials and controls that need attention now.
posture.partialHint: A plus sign means the read has more rows beyond this page, so the count is a floor.

secondFactor.label: People without a second factor
secondFactor.description: Active members without a confirmed authenticator code or registered passkey.

administrators.label: Administrators
administrators.description: Active owners and administrators in this organization.

apiKeys.label: API keys without expiry or unused
apiKeys.description: Registered keys with no expiry or no recorded use. Revoked keys do not count.

approvals.label: Pending approvals
approvals.description: Requests waiting for a person to approve or reject them.

killSwitch.label: Kill switch
killSwitch.description: The current stop posture for the estate and individual agents.

providers.label: Providers with a key
providers.description: Active provider credential registrations. Secret values are never read.

policy.label: Policy mode
policy.description: Whether signed-model admission is unconfigured, observing or enforcing.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Guardrail, anomaly and forensic findings. Evidence is a fingerprint — there is no payload to expand.
findings.emptyHint: Findings appear as guardrails, anomaly detection and forensics record evidence.
findings.namesUnread: Some session names could not be read, so those rows show their reference.

export.truncated: SARIF export downloaded, but it stopped at the server's result cap — it is a valid run, not the complete set.

triage.title: Triage finding
triage.description: Triage only changes the flow status. The evidence — kind, severity and the detail fingerprint — is immutable.
triage.immutableNote: Severity, kind and the detail fingerprint cannot be changed — only the flow status.

findings.truncatedHint: There are more findings than shown, and this page is ordered by ingestion id — NOT by when the problem occurred — so recent findings can be missing from it. The rest being out of view is not evidence that nothing else was found.

safetyPosture.title: Provider safety posture
safetyPosture.description: Read-first AI-safety posture ingested from the providers' own controls — OpenAI Moderation, AWS Bedrock Guardrails and Azure Responsible AI. Olivares reads and records it; enforcement stays with the provider.
safetyPosture.emptyHint: Connect the OpenAI, AWS or Azure connectors with their safety reads enabled to populate this view.
safetyPosture.countsPartial: Showing a partial roll-up — this organization has more safety posture findings than the summary scan covers.

guardrails.title: Guardrail inspect
guardrails.description: Run the guardrail inspection service over a surface. The text is hashed redacted and never stored — the result is a verdict plus minimal, already-redacted evidence.
guardrails.detectiveNote: This verdict only recorded the trip: it was detected, not blocked. A block is only possible when enforcement is enabled and governed.

form.textHint: Inspected and hashed redacted — never stored or returned.
form.enforceHint: Only blocks if the enforcement policy has this class enabled and governed; otherwise the verdict is a flag.

enforcement.title: Enforcement posture
enforcement.description: The one action that touches production. Each guardrail class only records by default; enabling inline enforcement is an admin action, governed where a gate is set up.
enforcement.defaultDetectiveNote: By default nothing is blocked: classes only block when explicitly enabled here and governed.
enforcement.fullyDetective: No enforcement is enabled — it records only and blocks nothing until you turn on a rule.

dialog.title: Change enforcement
dialog.description: Disabling (back to records only) is always allowed. Enabling inline enforcement is governed where a gate is set up — a governance denial is shown as the reason.
dialog.reasonHint: Recorded with the change for the audit ledger.
dialog.ungovernedWarning: Enabling this class without a governance gate set up leaves it ungoverned — the change is allowed but flagged.

anomalies.title: Anomaly queue
anomalies.description: Drift and correlated findings, ranked by priority. Approximate entries are unreconciled drift — never a firm violation.
anomalies.emptyHint: An anomaly is behaviour the detectors flagged for a human to judge. The queue is clear.
anomalies.unreconciledNote: Unreconciled drift — the reconciled authority is the access map. Priority is discounted; this is not a confirmed violation.

forensics.title: Forensic cases
forensics.description: Incident response — each case freezes its integrity state at open time, so a later tamper is detectable. The timeline is reconstructed from the append-only ledger.
forensics.emptyHint: A forensic case collects the evidence for one investigation. Open a case to start one.
forensics.timelineNote: Each event carries seq · hash · prev_hash so a reader can re-verify the link independently. There is never a payload behind an event.
forensics.truncatedHint: There are more cases than shown, and this page is ordered by opening id, so recent cases can be missing. An investigation you cannot see here is not an investigation that does not exist.

integrity.title: Ledger integrity
integrity.description: Two verdicts: the hash chain is internally consistent, and the signed checkpoints. Verifying is itself recorded in the chain it checks.
integrity.signingUnavailable: No signing key is set up — signed attestation is not faked.
integrity.checkpointsPendingNote: No checkpoint written yet — the chain verdict is what proves this ledger.
integrity.reverifyNote: Each event carries seq · hash · prev_hash so a reader can re-verify the link offline against an external WORM store.
integrity.chainEmptyNote: Nothing to verify yet — the ledger holds no events.

enforcement.title: No enforcement classes configured
enforcement.description: Rows appear only after a guardrail class posture is set; until then every class only records and nothing blocks inline.

findings.title: No security findings recorded yet
findings.description: Findings appear when guardrail inspection, observed-drift checks or provider safety posture record a signal, or another module raises a high-severity one.

cases.newHint: Opens a forensic case. The engine sets its status to “open”.
cases.title: Title
cases.linksHint: What this case is linked to: findings, ledger sequences, anomalies or notes.
cases.noLinksHint: Link findings, sessions and evidence to this case so the whole story is in one place. Nothing is linked yet.
